title: Us vs. Them: A Dataset of Populist Attitudes, News Bias and Emotions
measurement_description: The paper measured attitudes (ranging from supportive to discriminatory) and emotions expressed towards various social groups, including Muslims and Jews, in Reddit comments. This was done to analyze populist rhetoric and the 'Us vs. Them' dichotomy.
findings: In the dataset of Reddit comments, posts targeting Muslims received the highest amount of discriminatory content compared to any other group studied. Conversely, comments targeting Jews showed lower levels of critical and discriminatory language, with most attitudes being neutral, resulting in the lowest average 'UsVsThem' score among all groups. Furthermore, comments about Muslims and Refugees were most frequently associated with the emotion of Fear.
